posts.text: 💙 THAT'S A WRAP ON AMPLIFY SUMMER 🥹 This summer, I joined RBC Amplify as a Business Analyst, working alongside developers and cross-functional teams to tackle a real challenge at the bank. 💸 My team built ChequeMark, a solution focused on detecting cheque fraud in the night deposit channel. “You are studying business. What are you doing at a hackathon?” I get this question a lot. Being one of the few women in the room (and non-technical) can be really intimidating. I still remember signing up for my first hackathon in first year, having no idea what I would build or even where I would sleep that night. 🥳 FIRST PLACE at Ivey Marketing Summit! I’ve worked in several marketing roles but it was great getting to apply those skills in a real case setting. The Ivey Marketing Summit is Ivey Marketing Club’s flagship event, featuring some of the biggest consumer goods companies in Canada. It was an amazing opportunity to learn more about careers in branding, marketing, and sales. 📈 WINNERS @ Hack the North 🪿 Investing can be intimidating. So last weekend, we built a game that teaches students how to try. At Canada’s biggest hackathon, my team built TradeOff: a stock market simulation game that helps boost financial literacy by making investing fun and educational. We used a live news sentiment engine and a Python bot to simulate price movement, with real-time data powered by AWS DynamoDB Streams.
